title: Scaling
description:
[h1]Scaling[/h1]
An optional challenge you opt into one fight at a time. After every fight with rewards, you can pick up [b]Scaling[/b]. It makes enemies grow exponentially stronger while you grow linearly. Only the most busted runs should reach a scaling of 2.

[h2]Earning Scaling[/h2]
[list]
[*]Normal fight: +0.01
[*]Elite: +0.05
[*]Boss: +0.25
[*]Take no attack damage in a fight and two Scaling pickups are offered instead of one.
[/list]

[h2]Enemies (exponential)[/h2]
[list]
[*]HP, Block and defensive statuses: [b]× e^scaling[/b]
[*]Base damage and offensive statuses: [b]× 2^(scaling / 2)[/b]
[/list]

[h2]You (linear)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gold, Max HP gains, relic effects and potion effects: [b]× (1 + scaling)[/b]
[*]Card reward upgrade chance: [b]+scaling[/b]. Above 100%, each full 100% is a guaranteed extra upgrade.
[*]Every whole number of scaling: all your relics repeat their pickup effect, and compatible cards can be upgraded one more time.
[/list]

[h2]Configuration[/h2]
Starting scaling and the value of each reward can be changed in the Mod Config menu. The dev console has a [b]scaling[/b] command ([i]scaling add 0.5[/i], [i]scaling set 1[/i]).

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url]. In co-op, every player needs the same settings.

[h2]About this mod / 关于本模组 / 關於本模組[/h2]
This mod was made with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude). The Chinese translations (Simplified and Traditional) were also written by AI, using the game's official terminology, and have not been reviewed by a native speaker yet. If something reads wrong or unnatural, please let me know in the comments or open an issue on [url=https://github.com/Mainzu/ScalingMod/issues]GitHub[/url].
